name: court-rules
description: Judge-level filing rules, standing orders, local rules and court holidays for U.S. federal and state courts, plus privacy enforcement actions from 21 jurisdictions. Every rule cites the court's own document. Hosted remote server: sign in through your MCP client (OAuth), or send an API key from https://console.courtrules.app as an Authorization Bearer header.

http.description: Hosted streamable-HTTP MCP server. Your MCP client opens console.courtrules.app for a one-time sign-in (Google or email); no API key is needed for the sign-in flow.

tools.name: list_courts
tools.description: List courts with their judge counts. Pass query with part of a court name or ID to find one; results come in pages.

tools.name: search_judges
tools.description: Search for judges by district, name, or type. Returns judge name, slug, type, district, and status.

tools.name: get_judge_rules
tools.description: Get all extracted rules for a specific judge, from standing orders and individual practices documents.

tools.name: search_filing_rules
tools.description: Search extracted court filing rules: e-filing, service, filing timing, fees, courtesy copies, rejection or cure windows, and judge or courtroom preferences, with source provenance.

tools.name: list_court_holidays
tools.description: List court holidays and closure dates by district, calendar year, or date range, with official source URLs.

tools.name: check_compliance
tools.description: Build the parameters and a ready-to-use curl command for the Court Rules compliance check API (api.courtrules.app/api/v1/check). It does not run the check itself.

tools.name: search_enforcement_actions
tools.description: Search privacy and regulatory enforcement actions by jurisdiction, date range, industry, violation type, risk level, or entity name.

tools.name: get_enforcement_details
tools.description: Get full details of one enforcement action, including laws cited, remedies, source quotes, and document URLs.

tools.name: get_enforcement_stats
tools.description: Get summary statistics of enforcement actions grouped by jurisdiction, violation type, risk level, or month.

examples.title: Page limits
examples.description: Look up page limits for a motion in a specific court
examples.prompt: What are the page limits for briefs in support of summary judgment in EDNY?

examples.title: E-filing rules
examples.prompt: What Cook County e-filing rules apply to civil filings?

examples.title: Judge preferences
examples.description: Check a judge's courtesy copy rules
examples.prompt: What courtesy copy rules apply to Judge Reilly?

examples.title: Court holidays
examples.description: List the days a court is closed
examples.prompt: What holidays is EDNY closed for in 2026?

examples.title: Enforcement actions
examples.prompt: What privacy enforcement actions happened in California this year?
